cases.title: Number Button Input and Display Appending
cases.description: Verify that clicking number buttons (0-9) correctly appends each number to the display in sequential order, and that clearing the display resets the input sequence.

cases.title: Operator Button Input and Consecutive Handling
cases.description: Verify that clicking operator buttons (+, -, ×, ÷) correctly appends or displays operators, and that clicking multiple consecutive operators retains only the last clicked operator.

cases.title: Clear Button Functionality
cases.description: Verify that clicking the clear button completely removes all content from the display screen, and that clicking it on an already empty display keeps it empty.

cases.title: Backspace Button Character Removal
cases.description: Verify that clicking the backspace button sequentially removes the last character from the display, has no effect when the display is empty, and preserves valid preceding sequences.

cases.title: Expression Evaluation and Special Cases
cases.description: Verify that clicking the equal button evaluates valid arithmetic expressions containing numbers, operators, and parentheses, handles division by zero by displaying 'Infinity', and displays 'Empty!' for 2 seconds when evaluated on an empty display.

cases.title: Theme Toggle Functionality
cases.description: Verify that the calculator defaults to dark mode, and clicking the theme toggle button seamlessly switches between dark and light themes by toggling the 'dark' class on the calculator element and the 'active' class on the toggle button.

opinions.feedback: All proposed high-level test cases effectively cover the functional requirements, maintain distinct scenarios, and appropriately handle risk areas like division by zero and state clearing.
All cases accurately align with the given requirements and their cited IDs. No blockers were found.

analysis.analysis:
e2edev_bench_44-R-1: Testable behavior includes clicking number buttons (0-9) to append to display (data-testid='display'). Boundaries: empty display, post-clear state, full sequence '0123456789'. Normal path: sequential clicks append correctly. Abnormal/edge path: clicking numbers after clear starts a new sequence. Ambiguities: leading zero handling in numeric evaluation.

e2edev_bench_44-R-2: Testable behavior includes appending operator buttons ('+', '-', '×', '÷') with respective data-testids. Boundaries: empty display vs display with existing numbers, consecutive operator clicks. Normal path: operator appends to number or displays if empty. Abnormal path: multiple consecutive operators replace previous with last clicked.

e2edev_bench_44-R-3: Testable behavior is clearing display via data-testid='clear-button'. Boundaries: already empty display. Normal path: all content removed. Abnormal path: clicking clear on an empty display keeps it empty without error.

e2edev_bench_44-R-4: Testable behavior includes backspace functionality via data-testid='backspace-button'. Boundaries: empty display, single character, multiple characters. Normal path: removes last character sequentially until empty. Abnormal path: clicking backspace on empty display has no effect.

e2edev_bench_44-R-5: Testable behavior includes evaluating expressions via data-testid='equal-button', parenthesis support, and theme toggle. Boundaries: division by zero, empty display evaluation. Normal path: calculates valid expressions and shows result. Abnormal path: division by zero displays 'Infinity'; empty display shows 'Empty!' for 2 seconds then clears.

e2edev_bench_44-R-7: Testable behavior includes theme toggling via data-testid='theme-toggler'. Boundaries: initial dark mode state. Normal path: clicking toggles 'dark' class on calculator element and 'active' class on toggle button. Abnormal path: none identified; seamless and immediate toggle required.
